system.description:
Range: Self

Cost: 1 Resolve

You exhale a foul-smelling cloud.

Until the start of your next turn, every space within 5 spaces of you becomes Obscured (1), and any creature other than you that starts its turn in the area becomes Contaminated until the start of your next turn.

You may designate a number of creatures equal to your Training in Metaphysics to exclude from this effect.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect. Each time you sustain it, the radius increases by +1 space, to a maximum of 5 + your Soul.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.PXyDweU65lNtafLs]{Deathsinger's Miasma}
